_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: System Key Management Plan (SKMP)
summary: Specifies the format and content for a System Key Management Plan (SKMP) used by programs to facilitate key material ordering from the National Security Agency and provisioning of that keying material to the Contractor.
use_relationship:
The System Key Management Plan (SKMP) is used by programs to facilitate key material ordering from the National Security Agency (NSA) and provisioning of that keying material to the Contractor. This is accomplished by identifying the cryptographic equipment used by the system and defining the specific key material required.

The SKMP further describes the use and control of cryptographic products and services used by a cryptographic application (cryptographic engine, cryptographic module, or End Cryptographic Unit (ECU), or system) throughout its lifetime. The SKMP also identifies and documents the capabilities that the cryptographic application requires from the current and planned key management infrastructure.

When directed in the Statement of Work, the SKMP includes Annex 1, Cryptographic Security Plan (CSP).  This Annex describes the protection and recovery measures put in place for any cryptographic equipment, components, or keying material that may come into contact with or be operated in the presence of unauthorized personnel during the system's life cycle or due to failed launch.

This DID contains the format, content, and intended use of information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the solicitation.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

children.title: Committee on National Security Systems Policy (CNSSP) No. 12, Cybersecurity Policy for Systems Used to Support National Security Missions, February 2018

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The Contractor's SKMP shall contain narrative content, diagrams, and technical detail addressing each of the topics delineated in the following major sections and subsections. Provide data using the electronic preparation instructions below.

children.title: KEY AND CERTIFICATE MANAGEMENT PLAN PROCESS
Cryptographic Application Description and Security Services
Level of Information the Cryptographic Application is Protecting
Security Services the Cryptographic Application Provides
Key Management Products and Services Requirements
Key Management Products and Service Types
Description of Program Lifecycle (Schedule, Milestones, and Overlay of Same to Sections 3.2 - 3.10, below)
Description of Protection Measures: Access Control Procedures for Authorized Personnel
Description of Protection Measures: Control / Prevention of Access by Unauthorized Personnel
Description of Protection Measures: Action Plan for Failed Launch
Description of Protection Measures: Action Plan for Deorbiting of Space Platform
Contractor's Declaration of Implementation of Program Compliance Documents
Contractor's Estimation of CSP Sufficiency and Assessment of Residual Risk
SKMP/SKMP ANNEX 1 COMPLIANCE MATRIX
children.content: The Contractor's SKMP and SKMP Annex 1 (when directed) detailed in Requirements above, shall contain (either in the body of the document, or as an attachment to it) a complete Compliance Matrix that identifies where each line item is addressed in the SKMP.  The "Requirement Met?" column (D) is to be left blank to be completed by the Government during its review.
